item.title: Catseyes missing or damaged along entire stretch of road, 15th October
item.description:
As Gotherington is an unlit village, traffic entering and leaving via Gotherington Lane has to negotiate a dark narrow lane. I noticed the catseyes are non existent along the entire road, although the fittings look serviceable, so expect the 'reflectors' could be swapped out for new ones. Can these please be replaced to improve safety going into the winter?
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 20, Cleeve Road, Gotherington, Tewkesbury
